profile.intro: I build AI stuff and anything else I find interesting, RAG pipelines, multi agent systems, Full Stack apps, and generally anything that looks shiny at 2AM in the morning :)
notes: AI Engineer specializing in production-grade enterprise solutions for the retail and supply chain sectors across GCP and AWS.
I build multi-agent systems, advanced RAG pipelines, and cloud-native automation designed for system reliability and real-world scale.

I am a strong advocate for the judicious use of AI: deploying agentic workflows and LLM pipelines strictly where they solve core operational bottlenecks, cut friction, and drive measurable business impact—rather than chasing tech hype.
